description: This file defines the SlidingTabLayout class, a customizable tab indicator component for use with ViewPager in Android applications. It manages visual representation of tabs, customization options, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView that provides tab indicators synchronized with a ViewPager.

classes.name: TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface for customizing tab indicator and divider colors based on position.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for the tab indicator and dividers.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the selected tab indicator, as a circular array.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the tab dividers, as a circular array.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for page change events to synchronize the tab layout.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Defines a custom layout for tab views and the ID of the TextView within.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Links the layout with a ViewPager and populates tabs based on its adapter.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView used as a tab if no custom layout is provided.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Fills the tab strip with views for each page in the ViewPager.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the tab strip to make the specified tab visible.
